$comment: What this build changed this round, shown to the judge by src/round-notes.ts. Overwrite every round: your round number and 4-5 one-liners. npm run check validates the shape.
notes: A fourth act: THE HOLLOW, a burnt-black wood behind the third beacon where the game's one verb reverses - press to GIVE light, not take it
Kindling a hearth spends the whole reach; the hearth burns forever, banishes any shadow in its pool, scatters embers, and is where a death returns you
Leylines: every lit hearth runs a thread of light to the next cold one - walk it and the light carries you, and the hearth's breath lands on the road
Light the First Tree once all five hearths burn and the game ends in an earned dawn, not a fade to black
Jump straight there with ?level=4 if you have already walked the forest
